translation: One name is 陵苕, one name is 華, one name is 陵時. It grows at the West Sea and in Yang [zhou]. Original text of the Benjing: Campsis (紫葳), flavor sour, slightly cold. It chiefly treats leftover disease of women after childbirth and lactation, flooding, masses with blood stoppage, cold-heat and emaciation weakness, and nourishes the fetus.
